title: Green Space's TNT's
description: This mod is a TNT mod inspired by a lot of Minecraft modded TNT's. Note: This mod is not on forge yet, I have had some issues logging in so I switched to publishing this mod on Modrinth, sorry! will fix soon! v0.1, 4 TNT's. Bye!
body:
A simple small mod, inspired by other big modded TNT mods. current version is v0.1 (1.0.0) and its status is "Release" which means its highly stable and features are fully developed! for now we only have 4 types of new TNT

TNT: 4
Also I used Mcreator 2026.1 to build this, I hope to get to 2026.2 buts thats a snapshot being it has glitches and may crash mid modding so am staying on 2026.1 version, HIGHLY recommend Mcreator for beginners!

- Budget X-ray TNT replaces a chunk sized section with glass except ores, good for survival!
- Emerald TNT is like Budget X-ray TNT but it just simply replaces everything in the radius with emerald blocks! NOT emeralds
- Super TNT is like normal tnt but instead of a blast power of 4 its a blast power of 14!
- Ultra TNT is like Super TNT but the blast power is doubled (so 28!)

Bye! this mod is really good and it will have a version 1.0.1 (v0.2 for me) soon! why not try and add this to your world? also the list above is only tnt blocks, there are some extra non-tnt features I haven't added cause am in a rush to go to school!
